name: Fundido
summary: An expense app with conversational AI: you write to Fundi, the piggy, and it turns your sentences into expenses.
description: An expense tracking app with conversational AI: tell Fundi what you spent and it turns your sentence into an expense with description, amount, date and category.

architecture.presentation: ChatPage listens to ChatBloc: each message is an event and the state brings Fundi's answer.
architecture.domain: InterpretarGastoUseCase takes the chat history and depends on the GastoAiRepository contract.
architecture.data: GastoAiRepositoryImpl delegates to OpenAiGastoService, which builds the OpenAI request and parses the answer.

decisions.title: The AI returns data, not just text
decisions.body: The prompt asks for two parts: a short sentence in the user's tone and a JSON block with description, amount, date and category, which the app parses and stores.

decisions.title: Never confirm halfway
decisions.body: If a required field is missing, Fundi asks for it and does not say "logged": the expense is stored only once it has description, amount and date.

decisions.title: Relative dates resolved first
decisions.body: "Today", "yesterday" or "the day before" are turned into YYYY-MM-DD with the device date inside the prompt, so the model does not guess the day.

mediaCaptions.chat: The chat with Fundi, where expenses are added by typing.
mediaCaptions.analisis: Analysis: spending by category and the list of expenses.
mediaCaptions.login: Sign in with email or Google.
